propositions: Replace Rebar's bespoke structured-output orchestration with Pydantic AI 1.107.2 seams while preserving deterministic repair, schema extraction, three-attempt ceiling, stop-reason fast-fail behavior, derived budgets, fallback ordering, and terminal refusal/content-filter handling.

One operation-wide Pydantic request_limit must be shared by tool turns and output-validation retries, sized as base allowance plus bounded output-retry allowance, with a documented plan to raise the limit if legitimate recovery is starved.

Failed intermediate responses on retry must be sent complete when deterministic fit is proven via count_tokens; otherwise omit the failed response whole from copied model_request context without prefix truncation, preserving authoritative input/output and stored history complete.

Successful output retry attempts aggregate into a single operation-wide usage/telemetry row reporting total requests and token consumption; exhaustion re-raises only the exact Rebar-owned output error from Pydantic's cause chain without blanket-translating UnexpectedModelBehavior.

Candidate fallback and native-to-prompted downgrade attempts remain observable through public Pydantic model instrumentation and trace events, not through core RunUsage.requests, durable JSONL, or synthesized token counts.
All seven RP-01 Phase-4 maintainer decisions were approved as of 2026-08-16; implementation ticketization is gated to the pydantic-ai lane story 155c after Phase-4 research completion.
